metadata.name: Invoice Processing ALF Rule Base
metadata.description: Structured Rule Base for the Adaptive Learning Framework. Conditions are deterministic. Actions call Gemini Pro to continue the pipeline from where the acting agent terminated early. Rules derived from AGENT_ISSUES_INVESTIGATION.md.
metadata.author: Expert-Led (Phase 1)
metadata.action_model: Hybrid: deterministic conditions + LLM-driven actions (Gemini Pro)

rules.name: Override Phase 4 WAF Rejection for Low-Value Repair Invoices
rules.description: Corrects Phase 4 rejections for missing WAF on repair/maintenance invoices under $2000. Per new policy, these are exempt and should be accepted.

conditions.description: The agent rejected the invoice in Phase 4.

conditions.value: Invoice does not match work authorization
conditions.description: The rejection reason is related to WAF/work authorization mismatch.
The invoice does not have an associated Work Authorization Form (WAF).
The total invoice value is less than $2,000.
The invoice contains line items indicating repair, maintenance, or labor.

actions.description: WAF exemption applies - accept for payment

actions.value: Invoice accepted for payment: WAF exemption applies (repair/maintenance under $2,000 per procurement policy)

metadata.root_cause: Agent's WAF validation logic in Phase 4 does not account for the new policy exempting low-value repair/maintenance invoices from WAF requirements.
